title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：reality　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reality 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the elder ① faced the reality that no youth in the village would have counted, and he said the facing was the whole of the year. The ② reality, meaning the fact itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; reality, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ bit of reality in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ reality at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Reality, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the elder said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the reality was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the fact. The ⑥ reality, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; reality, he said, is either something you face or the only word that means both fact and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ reality had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ reality of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of counting; reality, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ reality I remember is the reality counted in the memoir, which closed in 1963 and is still counted as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Reality, my mother said in 1965, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all reality, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like fact. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 现实；真实（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 现实；真实（指那份现实本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：face the reality 正视这一份现实
D. n. 现实；真实（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 现实之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的现实之事）
F. n. 现实；真实（指回忆录里写到、被清点的那一份）
G. n. 现实、实情（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 实情（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: faced the reality that no youth in the village would have counted
The reality, meaning the fact itself and not the staff
Every bit of reality in that village
the reality at the far gate
the reality was the whole of the matter
the reality had become a line in a memoir
The reality of the whole thing

answers.why: face the reality 意为“正视这一份现实”，1956 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯清点的一份现实做了一遍。
reality 意为“现实；真实”，指那份现实本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
reality 意为“现实；真实”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
reality 意为“现实；真实”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
reality 意为“现实、实情”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份实情就是那件事的全部。
reality 意为“实情”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份现实，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
reality 意为“现实；真实”，指回忆录里写到、被清点的那一份，到 1961 年这一份成了回忆录里的一行。
reality 意为“现实之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的现实之事是一处村子和三个年头的清点。
reality 意为“现实；真实”，我记得的是回忆录里清点过的那一份，1963 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一份。
reality 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，现实是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的现实。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年那位长者正视了村子里没有一位后生肯清点的一份现实，他说这一遍才是那个年头的全部。（face the reality）
那份现实，指的是那份现实本身而不是短短的拐杖，经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。（reality）
那处村子里每一点现实旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。（reality）
最远那道村口那份现实，指的是他们留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（reality）
叔叔说这份实情就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那份现实。（reality）
1965 年母亲说，现实是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的现实。（reality）
